## What this next step can deliver

The owner has approved returning to a scientific core without a qualified
numerical replacement. We can now ask an author to explain what a declared
feedback method means and what must be true before its response, restart or
convergence claims are justified. The resulting draft should make predictive
statements under explicit assumptions, including what happens with zero
feedback, unequal removal/restoration support and a perfect model followed by
a non-identity output response.

This would be useful scientific closure even if no better FRUIT policy is
selected. It would not establish that the current implementation conforms,
that a numerical route is available, or that any reduction is qualified.

The [decision map](author_packet/SCIENTIFIC_DECISIONS_R0.1.md) resolves the
core direction while leaving numerical choices visible: parent route, model,
projector, recurrence, learning, stopping, uncertainty and consumer acceptance.
The author must expose any actual dependency on an unresolved choice. An
unselected numerical profile alone does not block conditional reasoning.

## Exact next owner decision

Approve the packet bound by [PACKET_MANIFEST_R0.1.md](PACKET_MANIFEST_R0.1.md).
This reviews the exact sanitized scope, core decisions, source reuse and
bounded author task. It does not ask for the already approved scope again.

Stage B also needs an explicit launch instruction, as required by the
approved scope's sequence clause 3. Packet approval and launch may be expressed
together, but approval of this preparation alone is not a launch. The future
manager must verify the manifest, prepare an isolated copy of only the six
author inputs and their input manifest, and commission the fresh
implementation-blind author required by the charter (GPT-5.6 Ultra, with no
inherited implementation context). Do not substitute another model silently.
The manager-only records and this README are not author inputs.

No author has been dispatched and no scientific core has been written or
frozen in this step. No new numerical experiment is proposed. Historical
Citlali remains the mandatory empirical control and a compatibility candidate;
its thresholds and detector policies have not become normative science.
Independent-pointing replication remains required before a policy
recommendation. Existing empirical conclusions, unavailable Gate D and
qualification states, production behavior, reduction products and both review
archives remain preserved.
